# tlsv1

```go
import tlsv1 "pocketone.dev/ext/contracts/tls/v1"
```

Package tlsv1 is the tls/v1 contract: the TLS of a multisite host's main listener (automatic certificates). With no provider the host uses the certificate files in its \`server\` section, or plain HTTP.

A host-scope service contract: providers register on the host's scope (ProvideIn), not on an app.

Source: [`ext/contracts/tls/v1`](https://github.com/pocketonehq/pocketone/tree/main/ext/contracts/tls/v1).

## Variables

<a id="contract"></a>

```go
var Contract = extkit.NewContract[Provider]("tls/v1", extkit.One)
```

Contract is tls/v1, on a host's scope.

## Types

### Provider

```go
type Provider interface {
	TLS(ctx context.Context, served func(host string) bool) (cfg *tls.Config, httpHandler func(http.Handler) http.Handler, err error)
}
```

Provider supplies the main listener's TLS. served reports whether a hostname belongs to an instance, for providers that must not issue certificates for anything else. httpHandler, if not nil, wraps the plain-HTTP listener's handler (tls.http\_listen), e.g. to answer ACME challenges. A nil config means "not this time" (the host falls back to its certificate files or plain HTTP).
